reviews.reviewerContext: /root/reach_render_review — separate read-only rendered-review agent; baseline reconciliation judged from fresh screenshots and recordings before source identity comparison
reviews.acceptanceScope: Anonymous desktop/mobile Reach software/browser experience in the fresh immutable D0 packet for candidate 8f163c322d8a0048985e8666dbd4cb0e15fd2650. Baseline reconciliation preserves the accepted three repair iterations; historical D1 photographic replay remains bound to candidate 632e1895a6fcd8ba4c82f1752f6b671131598a33. No unresolved blocker within this contract.

composition.observation: Fresh desktop preparation gives the registered camera the larger column and contextual guidance one side; calibration prioritizes the target plane. Phone calibration places compact acquisition above the plane. Dark sea-green panels, cream serif headings and brass rules form a coherent instrument within the visible shell. The flush-left Devices doorway remains legible and usable but needs minor spacing polish.

hierarchy.observation: Prepare, Calibrate, Check and Explore provide a clear progression. Camera/demo choices precede setup; hand count, posture readiness, acquisition and independent outcome use distinct text. Fresh FIT_READY says Independent check required and Not measured, so training completion does not imply validated accuracy. Detected-ineligible keeps observation separate from action eligibility.

typography.observation: Fresh 1440x900 desktop and 390x844 phone renders keep cream serif task/outcome headings and plain instructions readable. Uppercase/monospaced eyebrows identify stages without carrying readiness alone. Long text wraps within panels and phone result values retain their units and explanations. The photographic 1280x720 views belong to the historical 632e1895 supplement.

spacing.observation: Fresh phone acquisition, current target and ordinary controls coexist in one viewport: absolute NORMAL video 10s shows 47% collection at target 2, and 18s shows 73% at target 7 with saved count above the plane. At 24s independent target 1 and Pause check/Cancel check are visible together. Desktop guidance sits beside the plane. No horizontal scrolling was observed in inspected frames.

controls.observation: Enable live camera and Explore guided demo remain explicit alternatives. Relative movement is recommended and absolute pointing experimental. Conventional setup, pause/resume, retry, practice and return controls are visible. Fresh independent validation says Pause check and Cancel check. Demo condition controls disclose the simulated hand; its results do not claim physical accuracy.

contrast.observation: Cream instructions, brass buttons/outlines and mint status/progress are distinguishable against dark panels in the fresh renders. Text accompanies readiness and mode colors; amber provisional fit has an explanation. Focus outlines remain visible. Capture accessibility observations are supporting automated records, not exhaustive color-vision or assistive-technology qualification.

consistency.observation: Fresh shell/account access and brass/cream/sea-green treatment remain consistent with the accepted Homeport references inspected during the initial rendered review. Camera, target, status and results keep shared treatments across modes. Relative results use cursor error rather than absolute pointing error. The plain Devices doorway remains a minor visual mismatch.

states.observation: Fresh screenshots cover all fifteen required states. Pause exposes Resume calibration; FIT_READY requires an independent check; multiple detected hands expose an active-hand choice. Detected-ineligible preserves the detection count, instructs framing and withholds a usable pointer. Relative training/check/results and camera-unavailable recovery are distinct. Observation, posture, calibration and eligibility remain visually separate.

responsive.observation: At the fresh 1440x900 desktop viewport, camera/guidance and target/guidance use two columns. At 390x844 the camera leads preparation and compact acquisition leads calibration, followed by the plane and wrapped controls. Phone recording frames show targets and actions together during training, checking and practice. Expanded full-page stills shift sticky elements; actual viewport frames resolve obstruction. Physical phones are not qualified.

keyboard.observation: Fresh trace streams record Tab/Enter and role-targeted keyboard activation for entry, demo, setup, pause/resume, targets, independent checking, practice and return. ArrowDown selects the pointing radio; Home/ArrowDown/Enter operate the demo condition selector. Absolute streams each contain 27 key activations, relative 16 and recovery 4. These traces do not establish a complete linear Tab traversal or every diagnostic/screen-reader combination.

focus.observation: Fresh keyboard-driven viewport samples show bright focus outlines on the entry link, target plane and conventional controls; the reduced desktop recovery video has a focused return link at 6s. Recorded activations reach the expected outcomes and return without an observed trap. Full-page expansion alters shell/skip-link coordinates; sampled ordinary viewports do not show persistent target/control obstruction. A complete focus-order audit is not claimed.

feedback.observation: Fresh acquisition shows hold wording, percentage/progress and saved count beside the target: phone absolute NORMAL 10s has 47%, 18s has 73%; phone relative NORMAL 16s has 40% during its independent check; desktop relative REDUCED 8s has 67% during setup. FIT_READY requires five new targets and results identify the independent check. Fresh named readiness feedback is 826.7–873.4ms against a 5000ms budget, not every-control or sensor latency.

motion.observation: Samples from all twelve fresh NORMAL/REDUCED recordings preserve acquisition, target progression, outcomes, practice and recovery. No persistent obstruction or frozen stage appeared in inspected frames, and metadata/traces record the requested motion preference. Frame sampling cannot establish continuous smoothness or physical motion feel. D1 inference/canvas measurements are historical 632e1895 evidence and were not rerun for this candidate.

continuity.observation: Fresh entry frames at 0.5s show the Devices doorway and at 1s the camera-off Reach welcome on desktop and phone. Return restores Devices and the shared shell; conventional Device connections navigation remains available. All twelve fresh journey records preserve the same Voyagewright home-origin fingerprint before, at outcomes and after return. Historical D1 cleanup remains source-bound to 632e1895; authenticated/pairing authority is outside this anonymous contract.

complexity.observation: The fresh primary flow asks one task at a time: enable/demo, choose mode, acquire targets, independently check, practice or retry. Diagnostics/privacy remain collapsed. Demo sliders/conditions form a separately disclosed explanatory surface. Compact phone guidance repeats some text but keeps progress at the point of attention; the task does not require understanding the implementation.

role-outcomes.observation: The fresh anonymous Creator/Player can enter without pairing or camera permission, deliberately choose a labeled demo, distinguish hand/readiness stages, select absolute or relative setup, train, independently check five new targets, practice safely and return. Absolute stays experimental/session-local. Relative explicitly claims cursor control with cursor-error labels; demo results disclaim webcam accuracy. This accepts the bounded software/browser experience, with historical D1 support; D4 and owner approval are unclaimed.

fallbacks.observation: Fresh camera-unavailable renders say The camera could not start and offer Retry live camera plus Explore guided demo. Recovery recordings enter the disclosed demo and return conventionally; reduced phone return is visible at 5.12s. Pause/resume and detected-ineligible framing guidance provide intermediate recovery without equating detection with eligibility. The access-declined viewport remains historical 632e1895 evidence; no real webcam grant is claimed.

findings.observation: Initial phone screenshots put acquisition/progress about a screen away from the illuminated target, preventing convenient monitoring of a hold.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh evidence: compact status/progress is immediately above the target. Absolute phone NORMAL recording 10s shows 47% collection at target 2 with 1 of 9 saved; 18s shows 73% at target 7 with 6 of 9 saved. At 24s the independent target and check controls coexist. Relative phone NORMAL 16s shows 40% acquisition during its independent check. No ordinary viewport separation blocker remains.

findings.observation: Initial held-out validation incorrectly named its pause/cancel actions calibration, weakening the separation between fit and independent check.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh absolute and relative check renders: actions say Pause check and Cancel check. The plane labels an Independent check and explains that these new targets do not change the provisional fit. Fresh FIT_READY requests five new targets rather than presenting training as a passed check.

findings.observation: Initial photographic tracking said the camera was connected/ready while simultaneously requesting camera permission.
findings.resolution: Historical repair retained, with an explicit source boundary: the independently inspected 632e1895 photographic tracking viewport says Camera connected, Your hand is ready and Camera ready with a registered overlay and no contradictory permission request. After fresh rendered inspection, an identity-only comparison found no changes to the bounded Reach/camera/hand projection paths between 632e1895 and 8f163c32. Fresh packet tracking consistently labels guided demo/no camera. The D1 image is not a fresh packet artifact or new D1 runtime test.

findings.observation: The initial packet omitted recordings and complete relative, entry/return, paused/fit-ready and motion evidence, so significant acceptance could not be inferred.
findings.resolution: Resolved by the fresh packet: 84 screenshots, twelve recordings and twelve traces cover three journeys, both device sizes, both motion modes and all fifteen states. I inspected all distinct required NORMAL states on both devices, six representative REDUCED stills and 42 samples from all twelve fresh videos, then audited trace action streams and journey metadata. D4 and owner acceptance remain unclaimed.

findings.observation: Initial expanded stills apparently placed shell/skip-link elements across the stage; without viewport records their product/capture cause was ambiguous.
findings.resolution: Resolved as a capture-position concern in the fresh observed flow: ordinary viewport frames keep the shell above the working area and show current targets, compact acquisition and actions together. Expanded stills still shift sticky elements and create placeholders, so their expanded coordinates are not ordinary viewport geometry. Phone check 24s, practice 34s and reduced practice 34s show no persistent working-target/control obstruction.

findings.observation: Initial passed-results planes retained an obsolete instruction to hold at an illuminated acquisition target.
findings.resolution: Resolved in fresh absolute and relative passed planes: Your setup stays local to this pointing area appears under Independent check passed; the obsolete instruction to hold at an acquisition target is absent.

findings.observation: The returned Devices doorway is a legible plain link flush left beneath the shell, outside the centered/padded connection card. It works in the observed journey but is less visually integrated than Reach.
findings.recommendation: Place the existing doorway in the page's padded content/card hierarchy during Devices polish, preserving its ordinary accessible link. This does not prevent the bounded Reach objective.
